preconditions.description: The number of operators n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
Each of the n operator lines is non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(op.startswith('typedef ') or op.startswith('typeof ') for op in stdin_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each operator line starts with either 'typedef ' or 'typeof '.

preconditions.expression: all(not ('*' in B or '&' in B) for op in stdin_lines[1:] if op.startswith('typedef ') for B in [op.split()[2]])
preconditions.description: In typedef A B, the type name B contains no asterisks or ampersands.

preconditions.expression: all(B not in ['void', 'errtype'] for op in stdin_lines[1:] if op.startswith('typedef ') for B in [op.split()[2]])
preconditions.description: In typedef A B, the type name B is neither 'void' nor 'errtype'.

preconditions.expression: all(len(name) <= 20 and name.islower() and name.isalpha() for op in stdin_lines[1:] for name in [op.split()[1]] if op.startswith('typeof '))
preconditions.description: Type names in typeof operators are non-empty, at most 20 lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(count_stars <= 10 and count_amps <= 10 for op in stdin_lines[1:] for A in [op.split()[1]] if op.startswith('typedef ') or op.startswith('typeof ') for count_stars, count_amps in [(A.count('*'), A.count('&'))])
preconditions.description: In any operator, the number of asterisks and ampersands in the type expression A separately does not exceed 10.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout_lines) == sum(1 for op in stdin_lines[1:] if op.startswith('typeof '))
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of typeof operators in the input.

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('void') and line.count('*') >= 0 and line.count('&') == 0 and (line == 'void' or line.startswith('void*')) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid canonical type representation: 'void' followed by zero or more asterisks, with no ampersands.

postconditions.expression: all(line == 'errtype' or (line.startswith('void') and line.count('*') >= 0) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'errtype' or a valid void-based pointer type.

For each typeof A operator, the output line corresponds to the canonical form of A resolved according to the &K* rules: typedefs are processed sequentially, dereferencing void yields errtype, errtype absorbs all pointer/dereference operations, undefined types yield errtype, and &T* simplifies to T.
